fact: Togo First reports that the Ministry of Territorial Planning and Urban Development put two procedures, architect certification on a building permit application and application for and issuance of building permits, online on the national public services portal from early the week of 28 September 2026.

Togo First reports that the ministry's two procedures, five services of state broadcaster TVT and five of Radio Lomé, twelve in all, became available through the national public services portal from early the week of 28 September 2026.

Agence Togo Digital's site says it operates the National Portal for Digitalized Administrative Procedures (GNDAD, service-public.gouv.tg), a platform giving citizens and businesses a single point of access to administrative procedures by web, mobile and certified agents.

fact: The CNSS reports that on 21 April 2026 the national health insurance institute INAM officially launched its online services platform (SIAMU-INAM), including online registration of insured persons and electronic handling of care claims and reimbursements.
The CNSS reports that its online registration portal, open since 2018, lets employees and retirees, and since October 2025 non-salaried workers, affiliate and manage their rights online.
